title: Already In Changing Motion
about: A reflection on a year filled with overlapping life transitions.
description: This song was written about a period where multiple major life changes were happening at once. School, work, volunteering, business projects, and searching for a home all began moving forward simultaneously, creating the feeling of constant momentum.
lyrics: Verse 1
This year is already in motion
Before I even push the door
Things are quietly rearranging
Different than they were before
Days are bending into new shapes
Old weight loosening its hold
Every week feels like a soft step
Into something I don’t have to force
Pre-Chorus
I can feel the current moving
Under everything I do
Like the ground is gently shifting
Making room for something new
Chorus
This year’s big changes will flow and go smoothly
Like water finding where it belongs
Nothing is breaking, it’s only becoming
Already in changing motion
No sharp turns, no sudden falling
Just a long, wide open view
Life is unfolding without me pushing
Already in changing motion
Verse 2
What used to feel so heavy
Feels lighter in my hands
Doors don’t slam, they open slowly
Like they already understand
Time is stretching in my favor
Breath comes easy in my chest
Every small decision
Leads me somewhere I can rest
Pre-Chorus
I don’t have to see the whole road
To know the way is clear
Every step is being carried
By a year that’s on my side
Chorus
This year’s big changes will flow and go smoothly
Like seasons that know when to turn
Nothing is ending, it’s only rearranging
Already in changing motion
No rush forward, no resistance
Just a rhythm pulling me through
Life is unfolding without me pushing
Already in changing motion
Bridge
Some things are leaving without a fight
Some things are finding me
Some dreams are stepping closer now
Without me chasing what they’ll be
I’m not standing at a beginning
I’m not waiting at an end
I’m in the quiet middle movement
Where everything starts to bend
Soft Break
And it feels…
Like exhaling after holding too long
Like waking up inside a better season
Final Chorus
This year’s big changes will flow and go smoothly
I don’t have to make them arrive
Every shift is kind, every turn is gentle
Already in changing motion
No collision, no confusion
Just a widening point of view
Life is unfolding without me pushing
Already in changing motion
Outro
Already moving
Already forming
Already becoming something new
Already moving
Already forming
Already in changing motion
